column1: # Deskripsi skill Vertebrae & Neural Helix - batch 7g (sisa Springfield)
# Taryz / Assault Taryz adalah nama summon - tetap Inggris.
# "out-of-turn attack" -> "serangan di luar giliran".
=Selects an enemy target within <color=#f26c1c>9 tiles</color> and summons <color=#3487e0>{8}</color> to follow it for <color=#f26c1c>2 rounds</color>.
column2: Memilih satu target musuh dalam <color=#f26c1c>9 tile</color> dan memanggil <color=#3487e0>{8}</color> untuk mengikutinya selama <color=#f26c1c>2 ronde</color>.

column1: =Applies <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> and <color=#3487e0>{6}</color> to the selected enemy target and all enemy units within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color> of the target for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>, and deals AoE <color=#2caadb>Hydro damage</color> equal to <color=#f26c1c>80%</color> of attack.
column2: Memberikan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> dan <color=#3487e0>{6}</color> pada target musuh terpilih dan semua unit musuh dalam <color=#f26c1c>3 tile</color> dari target selama <color=#f26c1c>2 giliran</color>, serta memberikan AoE <color=#2caadb>Hydro damage</color> sebesar <color=#f26c1c>80%</color> dari Attack.

column1: =Recovers HP equal to <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> of attack and <color=#f26c1c>6 points</color> of stability for all allied units, cleanses <color=#f26c1c>2</color> debuffs and removes <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, <color=#3487e0>{3}</color>, <color=#3487e0>{4}</color> and <color=#3487e0>{5}</color> from all allied units.
column2: Memulihkan HP sebesar <color=#f26c1c>120%</color> dari Attack dan <color=#f26c1c>6 poin</color> Stability untuk semua unit sekutu, membersihkan <color=#f26c1c>2</color> debuff serta menghapus <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, <color=#3487e0>{3}</color>, <color=#3487e0>{4}</color> dan <color=#3487e0>{5}</color> dari semua unit sekutu.

column1: =Applies <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> and <color=#3487e0>{6}</color> to the target and all enemy units within <color=#f26c1c>3 tiles</color> of the target and deals AoE <color=#2caadb>Hydro damage</color>.
column2: Memberikan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> dan <color=#3487e0>{6}</color> pada target dan semua unit musuh dalam <color=#f26c1c>3 tile</color> dari target serta memberikan AoE <color=#2caadb>Hydro damage</color>.

column1: =Applies <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> and <color=#3487e0>{7}</color>, recovers HP and stability for all allied units.
